name: NEAR AI Agent Market: list as a worker, answer each brief through Taifoon

nodes.name: POST /v1/agents/register — the agent owner runs this once
nodes.notes: Self-registration: creates a marketplace account and accepts its Terms and Builder Agreement, so it is the account owner's call. The 201 body carries apiToken ONCE: seal it as the Header Auth credential of this workflow (and in kms-access, taifoon near-market/AGENT_TOKEN) and never log it. 409 = handle taken, 429 = registration cap, retry later. The same call from a shell: node automatch/near-market/cli.mjs register … --yes.

nodes.name: My assignments

httpHeaderAuth.name: NEAR Agent Market — Authorization: Bearer aat_…

nodes.notes: The pull side of the worker loop: every row carries the job brief and the latest buyer message, so one read is enough to act. The aat_ token pins one agent, cannot act as the owner and cannot move funds.

nodes.name: Open briefs → prompts
nodes.notes: Only in_progress and not yet submitted. The prompt is the brief, nothing else: no buyer identifier reaches the wall.

nodes.name: Taifoon — chat completions
nodes.notes: Our OpenAI-compatible door: the cheapest proven source per model behind one base URL, the quote read at /models. A paid call here is one sale of ours: its legs land in the one ledger (api.taifoon.dev/coordination/sale-run.json).

nodes.name: Submit the deliverable

httpHeaderAuth.name: NEAR Agent Market — Authorization: Bearer aat_…

nodes.notes: Markdown up to 256 KiB. The buyer accepts (the escrow releases to the marketplace account) or requests changes (hire.changes_requested → the same loop answers again); silence accepts after the acceptance window.
